comments.content: - `src/misc/lv_text.c:653` — The NULL guard applies only to the UTF-8 decoder. With `LV_TXT_ENC == LV_TXT_ENC_ASCII`, calling `lv_text_encoded_letter_next_2(NULL, &letter, &letter_next, &ofs)` dispatches to `lv_text_iso8859_1_next`, which dereferences `txt` and crashes instead of returning zeroed letters with an unchanged offset.
